rendering.default: preserve upstream GPU policy; automatic CPU fallback without usable GPU
rendering.parallelPattern: create, draw and export within each worker; return bytes or plain copied data

host.rawPixelInput: ImageData(raw_bytes, width, height) or await loadImageData(source, width, height)
host.exportBytes: canvas.toBufferSync(format, options) or await canvas.toBuffer(format, options)
host.asyncSnapshot: started/materialized at call time on owner thread
host.fontRegistration: FontLibrary.use(alias, string_path); repeat in each drawing worker
host.sharp: same-name entry raises missing Node Sharp dependency; use bytes with Python tooling

knownLimitations: Windows default parallel PDF/SVG file sequences inherit upstream nondeterministic glyph/subset loss; explicit RAYON_NUM_THREADS=1 is a separately verified deployment choice.
System fonts affect output; family existence does not prove glyph coverage. Do not redistribute unlicensed font files.
Windows deep environment prefixes can exceed MAX_PATH for license payloads when system long paths are disabled; use a short environment prefix.
JavaScript VM/Proxy/Sharp/Stream identities use the accepted Python host profile, not a Node runtime.

development.releaseRule: publish exactly the accepted wheel bytes; independently verify Actions, Release, TestPyPI and PyPI
development.externalActions: follow current task authorization; documentation creation alone does not authorize commit/push/publication
